pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: Senior Facility Agreement
between Lumenvale Industrie SAS, as Borrower, and Banque Exemple, as Lender.
Term facility in a principal amount of EUR 10,000,000.
Signed in Paris on 15 December 2025.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: Clause 2 — The Facility
2.1 Subject to the terms of this Agreement, the Lender makes available to the Borrower a term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of EUR 10,000,000 (the "Facility").
2.2 The Borrower shall apply the Facility towards the refinancing of its existing financial indebtedness and its general corporate purposes.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: Clause 1.1 — Definitions (continued)
"Net Financial Indebtedness" means, on any Test Date, the outstanding principal amount of the Facility less the Cash of the Borrower.
"Cash" means cash at bank and in hand and marketable securities shown in the accounts of the Borrower.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: "EBITDA" means, for any Reference Period, the gross operating surplus (EBITDA) of the Borrower, plus duly evidenced Non-Recurring Costs, without cap.
"Reference Period" means each period of twelve months ending on a Test Date.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: Clause 7 — Repayment
7.1 The Borrower shall repay the Facility in full in a single instalment on the Final Maturity Date, being 31 December 2029.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: Clause 9 — Interest
9.1 The Facility bears interest at 3-month Euribor plus a margin of 2.50 per cent. per annum, payable quarterly in arrears.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: Clause 19 — Financial covenants
19.1 Test Dates. The covenants in this Clause are tested on 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December of each year, the first Test Date being 31 March 2026.
19.2 Leverage. The ratio of Net Financial Indebtedness to EBITDA shall not exceed 3.50x on any Test Date up to and including 30 June 2027, and 3.25x from 1 July 2027.
19.3 Gearing. The ratio of Net Financial Indebtedness to Equity shall not exceed 1.00x on any Test Date.

pages.running_header: Senior Facility Agreement — Lumenvale Industrie SAS

blocks.text: 19.4 Interest cover. The ratio of EBITDA to Interest Charges shall not be less than 4.00x on any Test Date.
19.5 The Borrower shall deliver to the Lender, within forty-five days after each Test Date, a signed compliance certificate.

vision.title: The operating system for global corporate capital
vision.sub: Understand your debt. Control your capital. Unlock your next financing.

cards.title: From debt visibility to capital access

layers.title: Debt intelligence
layers.summary: Consolidation, contracts, covenants and reliable financial information.
items: Facility register across entities, lenders and currencies
Deterministic covenant engine with frozen saved calculations
Source tracing to trial-balance rows and contract clauses
Assisted contract extraction with human validation

layers.title: Capital decision-making
layers.summary: Capital structure, forecasts, scenarios and financing preparation.
items: Capital structure by instrument, provider, country and currency

layers.title: Capital access
layers.summary: Provider discovery, request workflows and financing comparison.
items: Financing requests with preparation checklist and brief export
Provider directory with transparent matching criteria
Indicative terms comparison under common assumptions
Secure sharing of information packages with providers

layers.title: Open capital infrastructure
layers.summary: Broader connections between corporate financing needs and capital providers.
items: Connections with banks, digital lenders and private debt funds
Standardised data exchange for credit processes
Selected regulated decentralised capital markets, where appropriate

cards.title: What it does not claim
items: No integration with banks, lenders, accounting systems or market-data providers.
No partnership with any capital provider; all providers are fictional.
No OCR or AI model: contract extraction is a simulated preview.
No regulatory approval, no lending and no investment advice.
No crypto assets, wallets or tokens. Decentralised markets are a possible long-term connection, nothing more.
